from collections import defaultdict
def solve(gi):
    H=len(gi);W=len(gi[0])
    C=comps(gi)
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cells in C:
        s=tuple(sorted((y-min(y for y,x in cells),x-min(x for y,x in cells)) for y,x in cells))
        groups[s].append((c,tuple(cells)))
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for s,v in groups.items():
        if len(v)==1: continue
        cs=[c for c,_ in v]
        ones=[t for c,t in v if c==1]
        if not ones: continue
        # non-1 target color(s)
        others=[c for c,_ in v if c!=1]
        tgt=others[0]
        for _,cells in ones:
            for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=tgt
    return out
